verdict.rationale: Omarchy's ISO install ("answer five questions") produces a finished system with developer tools already in place: Neovim, Lazygit, fzf/zoxide aliases, tmux, and OpenCode/Claude Code launchers. Community reports confirm a quick (~5 minute) install and an out-of-the-box setup. Language runtimes and frameworks (Rails, Laravel, Node.js) are installed separately, per environment, through the Install > Development menu, with Mise managing versions, so packages, tools and runtimes do not all arrive from one command. Missing for 10: a single command that provisions runtimes together with tools, documentation of exactly which runtimes ship by default, and hands-on corroboration of a one-step dev-environment setup.
